claim: The tweezers show laser status the same way on the laser safety switch, the laser warning sign and the control laser unit's front panel: a steady red light means the laser is powered but not emitting, and a flashing red light means it is emitting. A blue light on the front panel means system power is on.
validity_conditions: Read from Tweez 305/310 Laser Safety Manual V3.0, November 2022, as installed in C:/Program Files/Aresis/Tweez300/Manuals/ (sha256 264ab54b...): printed page 5 (PDF page 7), printed page 6 (PDF page 8). Also Tweez 305/310 General Hardware and Safety Manual V3.0, November 2022, as installed (sha256 1c112ed1...): printed page 6 (PDF page 8).
